material_type: The biofilm electrodes were collected with sterilized scissors in the anaerobic chamber for proteomic analysis.

sample_source.evidence: The biofilm electrodes were collected with sterilized scissors in the anaerobic chamber for proteomic analysis.

species.evidence: Differential protein expression levels were evaluated by comparing D. acetexigens cultures incubated with iron oxide minerals (i.e. hematite, goethite, magnetite) and D. acetexigens biofilm on the electrode of MECs, against cultures grown with a soluble electron acceptor (i.e. fumarate).

strain: D. acetexigens strain 2873 (DSM 1397) was obtained from the German collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures (DSMZ, Germany) as lyophilized culture and activated in the culture medium suggested by DSMZ.
